name: MODEL203
description: "A control amplifier built with new technology and without compromise for ""outstanding performance"".The RIAA playback curve is divided into two parts : 1 kHz or less belongs to the first stage, 1 kHz or more belongs to the second stage, and the feedback curve for each stage is designed to reproduce the best part of the RIAA curve.This increases the accuracy of the phono stage and provides twice the performance compared to other amplifiers.The phono stage divides the equalizer into two stages, with individual differential circuits for turnover and roll-off, and inverted Darlington circuits for voltage amplification.The power supply is stabilized by introducing a Darlington emitter-follower connection � voltage control stabilized power supply circuit. In addition, the emitter-follower circuit is used in each section for low output impedance.In addition, the power transformer is housed in a copper shield case, and the AC line is isolated from all circuits to achieve a high S / N ratio.A 13-position rotary switch is used for tone control, allowing independent control of 3 dB steps on the left and right sides. The Baxandall type filter has a differential-amplified and voltage-amplified circuit configuration.The master volume is a 22-position thick film detent volume.In addition, High gain and Low gain can be selected by switching the switch.High-quality parts such as GE, Sprag, RCA and Verden are used for each circuit part.Equipped with pre-switch button and power switch button.The pre-switch button controls the power supply of the preamplifier and the rear panel PRE and PWR outlets, and the power switch button controls the PWR outlet when the pre-switch button is ON.Equipped with High and Low filters, which act as a scratch filter and a subsonic filter, respectively.There was a wood case sold separately."

name: MODEL410
description: "A stereo power amplifier in pursuit of delicate and precise sound quality.Each output section of the Model410 is located on a separate heat sink module with two electrical connectors that connect the modules together. The heat sink has a thermal radiation area of 330 sq inches, and each module is placed vertically to allow natural heat reflux to flow above the amplifier.A specially developed power transistor is used for this output stage and a military-grade glass epoxy substrate is used for the output circuit board.The input amplifier stage is composed of high speed (15 MHz) and high slew rate (50 V / Ï‰ s).Both channels are equipped with a peak meter using 10 LEDs.The sensitivity of this meter can be changed in three levels : 0 dB, -10dB, and -20dB.The protection circuit features a turn-on / off and relay circuit that eliminates the speaker pop noise, as well as fail-safe speaker protection.The Model410 uses a relay output protection circuit that uses the magnetic arc cutoff phenomenon, based on research results that it is simple and reliable.The parts used are first class products such as GE electrolytic capacitors and Sprag capacitors, Arlen Bradley resistors, Motorola and RCA transistors, Verden cords, and ITT products.In addition, a large and highly reliable relay timer is used for speaker protection.The input gain can be controlled independently on the left and right.Equipped with a speaker selector switch of rating 20A, A-B switching comparison at high power level is possible.In addition, it has a headphone port, and you can enjoy it only with headphones by setting the speaker selector to the OFF position.There was a wood case sold separately."
